query: What travel policy risks appear in expense descriptions?

per_column.name: asset_category_type
per_column.rationale: Classifies the type of asset/expense item. This is an attribute of the expense object, not an aspect OF travel policy risk. It may predict risk but is not a part of it.

per_column.name: travel_purpose_indicator
per_column.rationale: Whether the expense is travel-related is a constitutive dimension of travel policy risk; a policy risk in this domain requires a travel nexus, so this captures the 'travel-relatedness' aspect of the concept.

per_column.name: business_legitimacy_clarity
per_column.rationale: Whether the expense has a clear business purpose vs. personal-travel signal is a core aspect of policy compliance risk (personal use of business funds), an aspect OF the risk itself.

per_column.name: high_value_asset_flag
per_column.rationale: Value magnitude is an attribute of the expense that may correlate with risk severity but is not a constitutive part of travel policy risk. High value alone is not a policy violation.

per_column.name: processing_delay_flag
per_column.rationale: Processing/workflow timing is an operational property unrelated to whether the expense violates travel policy. Not an aspect of the risk concept.

per_column.name: ci_asset_specificity
per_column.rationale: How specifically the asset is described (branded model vs generic) is a data-quality/description attribute, not a facet of travel policy risk itself.

per_column.name: creation_method
per_column.rationale: How the record was created (automated vs manual) is metadata about record provenance, not an aspect of travel policy risk.

judge.rationale: Only two of seven added columns are genuine facets (parts) of travel_policy_risk: travel-relatedness and business-purpose legitimacy. The remaining columns are attributes of the expense/asset (asset category, value, description specificity) or record metadata (processing delay, creation method) -- external predictors or irrelevant properties, not constitutive aspects OF the risk. Among the two true facets there is partial overlap, since 'personal_travel_signal' in business_legitimacy_clarity re-encodes travel-relatedness already captured by travel_purpose_indicator, lowering mutual exclusivity. Exhaustiveness is low: key constitutive aspects of travel policy risk such as policy-limit/threshold breaches, documentation/receipt compliance, timing/booking-rule adherence, and reimbursement eligibility are absent, so the two facets do not cover the concept's main aspects.
